# S3 Bucket Exposure Checker

> Free tool: paste an S3 bucket name and it sends two real, unsigned GET requests -- one asking the bucket to list its own contents, one asking to read its ACL -- to name whether anonymous listing is enabled and whether the ACL grants read or write access to AllUsers or AuthenticatedUsers.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
